openQuestions: Authoritative GIS/manual tracing is still needed for fine-grained historic/Ensanche/barrio morphology boundaries and for the exact Cartagena/San Javier transition in La Manga.

Current building-by-building occupation and massing in Los Camachos and Escombreras should be rechecked against dated orthophoto/GIS immediately before production freeze; 2026 concessions/plans are not assumed built.

Ensanche and ordinary apartment stock still need representative current facade/balcony/roof sampling beyond the documented heritage exemplars; the supplied 4–7 storey family remains a research envelope rather than a census.

Peripheral attached-house evidence is now strong for Los Dolores, Barrio Peral and Los Mateos, but current survival/replacement ratios and roof/material distributions remain unresolved by neighborhood.

La Manga, Mar de Cristal, Islas Menores, Los Nietos and Cabo de Palos need finer current building-form/height/facade sampling; planning categories and beach descriptions are not current building measurements.
El Hondón remains a remediation/current-state question; future land use must not be pre-committed until remediation and adopted planning clarify it.
Naval/shipyard areas intentionally remain coarse contextual massing. This catalog does not seek or encode sensitive internal operational geometry.
The provisionally approved 2026 PGMO revision remains planning-state evidence and must be rechecked for legal status before any production freeze.
